notes.title: Demo Update & Simplified Chinese Now Supported!
notes.notes:
Hey Adventurers!

Untraveled Lands: Chantico has updated the Demo to include a Simplified Chinese version! Update game to the latest version to experience it in Chinese. 

Besides Simplified Chinese, we are also working on localizations for Traditional Chinese, Russian, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), German, Japanese, French, Polish, and Korean. Stay tuned!

Since the Demo release, we've received lots of feedback and have made several updates and fixes:

Resolved various bugs that were blocking the game, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.
Added the Altar recipe to the journal to prevent it from being lost when removed from the playing field.
Improved the management and consumption of food for a more balanced gameplay experience.
Monkeys no longer consume food at the end of the day. Players now need to feed them bananas only to tame them.
Adjusted exploration times for better pacing and challenge.
Added a dedicated confirmation for videohints to prevent them from being closed accidentally or due to errors.


We're committed to collecting your suggestions and feedback to keep improving the Demo and provide a better gaming experience! Feel free to join our discord channel or follow our Twitter (X) account to stay updated on the game's progress or to chat and connect with other players!

If you enjoy the Demo, please adding it to your wishlist. Your support means a lot to us during the development process!
